description_en: Updates a single feature in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model of a specified product. This operation also supports updating the extended description of the TSL model
description_zh: 更新指定产品物模型中的单个功能，支持更新物模型扩展描述
name: UpdateThingModel

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or the </ph></props>ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product.

You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to obtain the ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey。

可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看ProductKey的取值
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The original identifier of the feature.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150319.html and view the identifier of a specific feature in the TslStr response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
功能原有的标识符。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150319.html，从返回参数**TslStr**中查看具体功能的**identifier**
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The new feature definition details.

If Identifier is not empty, the identifier of the feature is updated. The value can contain the identifier definition of at most one feature.
If Identifier is empty, the input or output parameter definitions of a service or event are updated. The value can contain the definitions of multiple parameters, up to 50.

For more information about how to write ThingModelJson, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html
parameters.help_zh:
新的功能定义详情。

Identifier不为空时，表示更新功能的标识符，最多能包含1个功能的标识符定义信息。
Identifier为空时，表示更新一个服务或事件下，输入或输出参数的定义，可包含多个参数的定义信息，最多不超过50个。

ThingModelJson的编写指导，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html
parameters.name: thing_model_json

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom module in the TSL model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If neither this parameter nor FunctionBlockName is specified, the feature in the default module is updated
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

此参数和FunctionBlockName均不传入时，更新默认模块中功能
parameters.name: function_block_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom module name of the TSL model. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or a Japanese character is counted as one character.

If neither this parameter nor FunctionBlockId is specified, the feature in the default module is updated.

If this parameter is specified, it must be used together with FunctionBlockId to modify the custom module name that corresponds to FunctionBlockId.

The default module name cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
物模型的自定义模块名称。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字和下划线（_），长度限制为4～30个字符，一个中文、一个日文算1个字符。

此参数和FunctionBlockId均不传入时，更新默认模块中功能。

如果传入此参数，必须与FunctionBlockId结合使用，可修改FunctionBlockId对应的自定义模块名称。

不支持修改默认模块名称
parameters.name: function_block_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
